pages: B156, alternate personalities, through B162, before quirks
review: Remaining major disadvantages enumerated, including identity packages, resistance/penetration/exposure distinctions, injury restrictions and supernatural event contracts. B161 vulnerability table visually reviewed. Runtime and independent fixtures pending.

entries.acceptance: Alternate personalities cost base -15 with self-control and require at least two equal-priced mental packages, each with at most five quirks. Author may approve differing intelligence/perception/will or mental advantages. Charge package price once plus the switching trait; physical traits, skills and unpackaged mental traits remain shared.

Stress prompts personality-switch self-control no more than once per game hour. Failure activates another package, selected by the author or an explicitly configured random selection. Reactions are -1 generally or -3 from witnesses of a change. Keep one actor ledger and do not clone inventory, injuries or advancement when switching.
Equal mental packages priced -21 each plus base switching at self-control twelve total -36, regardless of having two or three packages. Reject unequal package totals before changing the actor.

Squeamishness is base -10 with self-control and uses the full stimulus-fear procedure for unpleasant small creatures, gore and filth. Do not equate it to all insects, clean soil, ghosts or every large reptile; author identifies the actual disgusting stimulus.
Negative status remains a disadvantage accounted through B28 status rules. Reuse that social/accounting contribution rather than introducing duplicate credit in this catalogue.

Stress regression normally requires an uplifted-animal ancestry. Fear, anger, fatigue or injury prompts self-control. After stress ends, retry each minute with +2 for comforting friends and another +2 if a helper has human/animal empathy. Passing out from fatigue/injury ends the episode on waking.

Mild stress regression costs base -10: intelligence is required to utter a sentence, complicated machinery is unavailable, and weapon attacks are wild at -4. Own the episode rather than permanently lowering intelligence or removing skills.

Moderate regression costs base -15, includes mild effects and requires intelligence to understand a sentence. Being challenged/attacked requires self-control to avoid an authored instinctive reaction.

Severe regression costs base -20 and prevents speech, language comprehension and tool use except possible club-like use, with instinctive behavior throughout. Additional selected mental restrictions add half their negative cost, fractions discarded, before the regression self-control multiplier.

Stubbornness costs -5, gives -1 reactions and requires an authored reluctance to accept others plans, potentially overcome by persuasion. Do not require a new arbitrary will check for every action without an applicable procedure.

Speech impairment costs -10, gives -2 reactions where conversation is necessary and -2 to diplomacy, fast-talk, performance, public speaking, attraction and singing. Author specifies excluded speech-dependent occupations. The unpleasant-voice entry uses these same effects.

Concealed supernatural features require specific observation conditions and then affect reactions and relevant identification rolls. They cannot earn credit with the two most extreme frightening appearance categories; less extreme appearance levels remain compatible. Author defines the secret and qualified observers.

Cold body costs -5 with -1 reactions from physical contact and +1 to deduce supernatural origin. If warmth can be gained temporarily, cost is -1; record its actual duration and conditions rather than permanently suppressing the feature.

Absent reflection costs -10: mirrors, reflective surfaces and camera images do not show the actor. Observers who notice react -2 and get +2 to deduce supernatural origin. Define optical capture behavior without treating the actor as invisible to ordinary direct sight.
Absent shadow costs -10, with -2 reactions and +2 origin inference from observers noticing it. Remove cast shadow across light directions/intensities without suppressing direct visual perception.

Unnatural pallor costs -10, or -5 when temporarily suppressed by an authored condition. In adequate light without covering makeup, observers react -2 and get +2 to infer the supernatural origin. Track suppression and observation conditions.

Psychic crowd sensitivity costs -15. Unshielded nonmachine sapient actors with intelligence at least six within twenty yards cause dexterity/intelligence penalties: -1 for one to nine, -2 for ten to ninety-nine, -3 for one hundred to nine hundred ninety-nine, continuing by powers of ten. Collapse if either score falls strictly below half its original value. Recover action when the offending noise abates.

Psychic crowd noise reveals presence and approximate count within twenty yards, not locations or thoughts. Exclude machine minds and any effective telepathic shielding before counting. Define whether overlapping forms/companions count as distinct minds through the actor identity model.

Resistance susceptibility subtracts levels from health checks against an authored harmful class, costing -4/-2/-1 per level for very-common/common/occasional classes. Normally maximum five levels per class and two classes without approval; effective unmodified health cannot fall below three. Incompatible with resistance protecting against the same class.

Trace doses that would not ordinarily affect others prompt health plus one minus susceptibility level. Failure applies half the normal dose consequences, including injury/fatigue/attribute loss/incapacity duration. Author determines actual exposure and effect scaling; do not treat susceptibility itself as an injury multiplier.

Terminal deadline costs -100/-75/-50 for death within one month/one year/two years. Beyond two years grants no credit, and short campaigns should disallow irrelevant deadlines. Persist actual source/calendar deadline rather than rerolling lifespan on load.
entries.implementation: Health provides an acquired one-year condition, fixed -75 character value, explicit authored calendar length and guarded death deadline. No spendable points are awarded. Other duration tiers, creation purchases, cure and buy-off remain pending. Deadline and persistence fixtures authored and unrun.

entries.acceptance: Extending life beyond the terminal deadline requires buyoff. If points are insufficient, author-approved related disadvantages can settle the difference. Update deadline, underlying cause and character accounting atomically; no additional credit for already represented restrictions.

Exotic-transit sickness costs -10 in campaigns with regular time/dimension travel or teleportation. Prohibit related psionic talents, spells, technological skills and orientation-after-transit skill. Each transit prompts health: success stuns for one die times ten minutes, failure one die hours, critical failure twice that failure duration.

The author may define faster-than-light transit variants of exotic-transit sickness with equivalent mechanics. Specify eligible transit events and resulting stun behavior explicitly rather than applying ordinary immediate-recovery stun rolls to a fixed-duration condition.

Compulsory signature costs -5 for an untraceable quickly left sign; the actor cannot leave the scene until it is done. Author defines actual materials/action, separate from the main mission objective.
Complex signature costs -10, takes at least thirty seconds and gives investigators +2 criminology/forensics to identify or trace the actor. Commit elapsed time and persistent scene evidence.

Elaborate signature costs -15 and allows authored investigative clues without a successful investigation roll. Only one signature trait can earn credit; several acts form one composite signature severity.

Dangerous trickery is base -15 with a daily self-control check; failure requires attempting to outwit a genuinely dangerous target. Each resisted day adds cumulative -1 until a failed check. Own daily check identity and accumulated penalty; harmless pranks do not discharge the obligation.

Truthfulness is base -5: self-control to omit an uncomfortable truth, at -5 to tell a falsehood. Failure discloses truth or makes the lie obvious. Fast-talk always takes -5 and acting takes -5 when used to deceive. Keep the actual communicated content authored and avoid exposing unrelated private facts.
entries.validation_note: Fixed controlled trait and owned omission/falsehood triggers now select only authored relevant communication outcomes; shared skill penalties are reused without duplication. Outcome, replay, rollback, undo and save-continuation assertions authored, unrun. Parser/dialogue delivery and wider social contest integrations remain incomplete.

entries.acceptance: Uncontrolled predatory appetite is base -15 for an authored resource obtained from sapient beings. Opportunity prompts self-control at -2 for deliberate temptation or sensed abundance; if feeding restores health add -1 per missing health point. Failure requires feeding, followed by another control check to stop when satisfied; failure then causes dangerous overfeeding.

Poor fitness costs -5 and gives -1 to health checks without reducing the attribute or health-based skills, and doubles fatigue loss from exertion, heat and similar causes. Severe form costs -15 with -2 health checks and half fatigue recovery, and prohibits resistance traits. Neither alters fatigue spent powering magic/psionics.

Absent natural healing blocks daily health recovery and natural crippling recovery. First aid can stop bleeding but it and physician care cannot restore health; natural-healing accelerants do not help. Author-defined surgical, repair or exotic restoration may still work according to body nature.

Partial absent healing costs -20: natural healing is available under one authored rare condition, and health can be stolen through an existing appropriate power. Total absent healing costs -30 and prohibits both natural healing and health theft. Do not infer immunity to all external repair/healing from the latter.

Single-timeline existence costs -5 only where paradox/history erasure can occur. The actor lacks memory of paradoxes and severe changes may erase them through an authored event. Alternate worlds have no counterpart and grant the unrecorded-identity benefit there. Campaign may disallow this for player characters.

Bad luck costs -10 and gives the author one adverse event each play session. It cannot kill the actor outright. Own the used-session marker, concrete consequence and any selected theme; a theme is not a guarantee that every event fits it.

Unusual biochemistry costs -5. Appropriate specialized drugs cost ten times normal; ordinary drugs roll one die: one to three normal effect, four/five normal plus an authored harmful effect, six no effect. Normal food remains usable. Do not automatically select the illustrative one-die fatigue consequence for every drug.

Binding vows cost -5/-10/-15 for minor/major/great inconvenience. Author specifies obligations and judges impact. Credit cannot overlap an equivalent ordinary disadvantage; finite vows require buyoff when their term ends, and terms shorter than one year do not qualify under this procedure. Early release can require authored penance.

Minor vow patterns include daylight silence, dietary exclusion and abstinence; major patterns include rejecting edged weapons, complete silence, outdoor sleeping or strict carried-property limits; great patterns include unconditional aid, always using the nondominant hand, an overriding pursuit or compulsory challenges. Each authored instance needs a concrete action restriction and its ordinary consequences.

Attack vulnerability multiplies damage that penetrates armor and then applies ordinary wound-type multipliers. Independent fixture: one penetrating point times four vulnerability times one-and-a-half cutting gives six injury. Do not multiply armor reduction or basic attack damage before penetration.
Attack vulnerability to a rare class at injury multiplier 2 costs -10. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a rare class at injury multiplier 3 costs -15. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a rare class at injury multiplier 4 costs -20. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a occasional class at injury multiplier 2 costs -20. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a occasional class at injury multiplier 3 costs -30. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a occasional class at injury multiplier 4 costs -40. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a common class at injury multiplier 2 costs -30. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a common class at injury multiplier 3 costs -45. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a common class at injury multiplier 4 costs -60. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a very-common class at injury multiplier 2 costs -40. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a very-common class at injury multiplier 3 costs -60. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.
Attack vulnerability to a very-common class at injury multiplier 4 costs -80. Printed table visually inspected; category uses B46 defense rarity and author approval.

More than two attack vulnerabilities require approval. A specific defense against the same attack class, including tailored armor/resistance, cannot coexist with that vulnerability. Supernatural durability can coexist but its interaction must follow the source durability restrictions.

Fatigue-only vulnerability is -50% and affects specified fatigue-draining attacks or mundane fatigue causes instead of injury. Keep spending to power abilities distinct unless explicitly part of the defined cause.
Weak bite costs -2 and subtracts two per die after computing ordinary bite damage. Preserve damage minimum and dice/add conventions from the combat engine.

Exposure weakness inflicts direct health loss ignoring armor/defensive advantages: one die per minute costs base -20, per five minutes -10, per thirty minutes -5. The trigger cannot be ordinary food or something equally easy to avoid. Own exposure accumulation and each damage tick.

Exposure weakness rarity multipliers are one half/one/two/three for rare/occasional/common/very-common. One-die-per-minute very-common exposure costs -60. More than two forms require approval. These rarity multipliers also resolve the referenced substance-repulsion pricing.

Fatigue-only exposure weakness is -50%, replacing health loss with fatigue. Variable-intensity exposure is -40%: one authored common barrier halves damage rate while intense sources double rate. Modify tick intervals rather than silently halving each die result, and define changing-intensity accumulation.
Below-average wealth remains a disadvantage under B25 wealth accounting. Include its existing contribution once in point totals and disadvantage caps.

Attraction of strange events costs -15. Author supplies inconvenient supernatural encounters, sometimes beneficial, without immediate lethal outcomes. Informed ordinary observers react -2; interested investigators/enthusiasts may instead follow the actor. Specify event obligations and consequences rather than claiming a generic callback completes this trait.

Compulsive work costs -5 and requires at least one-and-a-half ordinary workday duration, with resulting sleep loss through the shared time ledger. Initial reactions may be +1 but prolonged neglect produces -1/-2 from affected observers. Author defines baseline workday and relationship history.

Persistent open wound costs -5 without initially missing health. Informed attackers can target it at -7 with one-and-a-half wounding multiplier; blood agents reaching it count as entering broken skin. Daily first-aid/physician dressing prevents the -3 infection-resistance penalty in disease-ridden surroundings. Own dressing date and wound location; resolve its multiplier with location/type rules.
entries.validation_note: Fixed price, source effect assessment, owned critical-recovery acquisition and daily dressing authored. Successful care changes live wound/surgical acquisition and daily infection resistance in plague-ridden surroundings without healing HP. Fixtures unrun. Same-day retries, live attack targeting, damage composition and blood-agent entry remain incomplete. Blood-agent entry now recognizes established contact with an active persistent wound; the poison lifecycle remains incomplete.

entries.acceptance: Compulsive attraction to strangers is base -10 with self-control on meeting a strange/exotic being; failure assumes willingness to interact socially. Fear checks for strange creatures receive +4/+3/+2/+1 at self-control six/nine/twelve/fifteen, with equivalent nonplayer reactions toward exotic characters. The assumption does not determine the other actor actual attitude.
